answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 3431 Country: India Title: kalipoth ka lacha which is given in my marriage, can i wear it as normal jewellary but not as a custom? Question: kalipoth ka lacha which is given in my marriage, can i wear it as normal jewellary but not as a custom? Answer ID: 3431 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 356/316=B) We do not know kalipoth ka lacha , what type of jewellery is it? However, you should remember this principle that every jewellery of gold and silver is allowed for women provided it particularly has no resemblance with non-Muslims women. Note: If kalapth is a necklace of pearls then there is no wrong in wearing it as a jewellery. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
